claims.quote: Generally considered endemic to coastal watersheds of Guyana and Suriname with type locality the Essequibo River, Guyana, but recent records suggest it or a similar-looking, unidentified congener may also occur in the Orinoco and Negro drainages in Venezuela and Brazil.
